description: Events over a period (default: the next 30 days, at most 366): Moon phases (super and micro full Moons), lunar perigee and apogee, lunar and solar eclipses (with a place: how they look from there), equinoxes and solstices, the Earth's perihelion and aphelion, planet oppositions, conjunctions and greatest elongations, and the next key events of the missions (flybys, arrivals, launches) from Perigee's catalogue.

days.description: Length of the period in days (default 30).

kinds.description: Kinds of events to include (default: all).

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. "Europe/Paris".

name: perigee_events
title: Astronomical and mission events
